import sys

def main():
    input_lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    totalLines = int(input_lines[0])
    inputString = input_lines[1].lower()
    originalString = inputString
    characters = list(inputString)
    sb = list(originalString)
    stack = []
    for c in characters:
        stack.append(c)
    bracketPositions = []
    for i, c in enumerate(characters):
        if c == '(' or c == ')':
            stack.pop()
            bracketPositions.append(i)
    pairsMap = {}
    for i in range(0, len(bracketPositions), 2):
        pairsMap[bracketPositions[i]] = bracketPositions[i + 1]
    removeIndices = []
    for startIdx, endIdx in pairsMap.items():
        for i in range(startIdx, endIdx + 1):
            removeIndices.append(i)
    removalSet = set(removeIndices)
    filteredChars = [characters[i] for i in range(len(characters)) if i not in removalSet]
    replacedChars = []
    toggleFlag = True
    for i in range(len(characters)):
        if i in removalSet:
            if characters[i] in ['(', ')', '_']:
                if toggleFlag:
                    replacedChars.append(' ')
                    toggleFlag = False
            else:
                replacedChars.append(characters[i])
                toggleFlag = True
    finalStr = ''.join(replacedChars)
    partsAfter = finalStr.split(" ")
    lengthAfter = [len(p.strip()) for p in partsAfter if p.strip() != '']
    replacedStr = inputString.replaceAll(r"\(.*?\) ?", " ").replace('_', ' ')
    partsBefore = replacedStr.split(" ")
    lengthBefore = [len(p.strip()) for p in partsBefore if p.strip() != '']
    lengthAfter.sort()
    maxLength = lengthAfter[-1] if len(lengthAfter) > 0 else 0
    print(f"{maxLength} {len(lengthBefore)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
